name: UWP December Destination, 29 December 1999

date.source: The post's own dateline; the announcer's own in-broadcast line names the event (rendered in the source text as "December Detination").

notes: A joint supercard fielding wrestlers from the coalition's own member federations. Two Unified titles changed hands: the reigning Women's champion lost her title in a bloody, weapons-heavy singles match, and a new World-Held champion won a piledriver-and-powerbomb brawl fought partly on the arena floor. Every combatant is billed only by the member federations that field them, per this coalition's own hub structure; no wrestler is minted as a character of this wing.
